result.title: Benchmarking language models and agents for scientific reasoning in evolving materials laboratories
result.summary: Large language models and the multi-agent systems built around them could accelerate materials discovery by connecting scientific knowledge with experimental decisions. Existing benchmarks establish capabilities in domain knowledge, multimodal interpretation and scientific tool use. As language models increasingly support materials research workflows, their ability to distinguish closely related material states and reason accurately with quantitative evidence remains insufficiently evaluated. These abilities are essential for comparing material responses, assessing mechanisms and maintaining reliable judgements as experimental evidence accumulates. We introduce MatScope to evaluate three connected capabilities. M1 tests unaided, condition-specific reasoning through 200 tasks spanning ten research functions, using aluminium and high-entropy alloys as representative material systems. M2 tests agent-assisted transfer of related knowledge to unresolved materials questions. MatEvoBench-20 tests initial forecasts across scientific dependency chains and revisions of still-hidden responses as observations accumulate. Across eleven model deployments, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, given-input calculations and many physical explanations are handled well. Fine-grained response estimates, comparisons between similar states and quantitatively supported choices remain substantially weaker. Related literature improves selected estimates, while condition and baseline mismatches limit transfer. Progressive observations calibrate some downstream responses and destabilize earlier accurate predictions. MatScope establishes measurable targets for developing reliable scientific reasoning in future self-evolving materials laboratories and materials-aware world models.

AI.brief_summary: MatScope 是面向演化材料实验室的科学推理基准，含三项能力：M1 用 200 个任务测模型在铝合金与高熵合金上的条件特异推理，M2 测 agent 辅助下知识迁移，MatEvoBench-20 测科学依赖链上的初始预测及随观测累积对隐藏结果的修订，共评测十一种模型部署。
AI.relevance_reason: 其证据逐步累积下的预测修订、相近材料状态比较与定量证据选择，可能为 LVR 中内部状态的证据整合、更新与信念稳定性评价提供问题表述上的启发；但基准以材料科学文本与数值推理为主，与视觉表征和 latent 生成无直接联系，任务形式可供核查。
